t: Contains the most popular sizes of stainless steel button, countersunk star-pin and clutch head security screws. For use as anti-vandal fasteners. Supplied in a handy carry case with separate inner compartments.
b: Contents: Countersunk head (#8 x 3/4" (60), #8 x 1" (60), #8 x 1 1/4" (35) and #8 x 1 1/2" (25)), button head: (#8 x 1" (30) and #8 x 1 1/2" (30)) and one-way head (#10 x 1 1/4" (30) and #10 x 1 1/2"
Use in Sheet Metal or Wood
